top_signals.title: Core PCE Momentum Remained Elevated in October
top_signals.summary:
US consumer spending stalled in October after surging earlier in the year, suggesting households took a breather heading into the holiday season. 
Inflation-adjusted personal spending was little changed from a month earlier, according to Bureau of Economic Analysis data released Wednesday.
Mike Reid, Senior US Economist at RBC, reacts to the inflation data. (Source: Bloomberg)
